Daejeon City Tour — essentials

Who runs it Daejeon City Tour (bus), Story Tour (walking), Travel Lounge (free old-town walks), plus self-guided and cycling routes. 37 routes in total.

Fares Regular bus course 10,000 KRW · Bread Tour 8,000 KRW · Middle/high-school students, under 13, over 65 and groups of 20+ pay less. Meals, entrance fees and activity fees are not included.

Booking Online only, first come first served: daejeoncitytour.co.kr. A QR ticket is sent after payment. Phone +82-42-254-4555.

Where to board Daejeon Travel Lounge — exit 4 of Daejeon Station, 5–7 min through the underpass. Daejeon City Hall South Plaza — exit 1 of City Hall Station, 3–4 min on foot.

Refunds 70% two days before, 50% one day before, none on the day.

Weekly Mon–Fri: Daejeon Masil A (Tue·Thu) and B (Wed·Fri). Weekends: Saturday Masil, Sunday Masil and the Bread Tour (routes A and B, four bakeries each, 40–50 min per stop).
